div.head: II Cn 49
div.ab: Gif hwa hadbryce gewyrce, gebete þæt be hades mæðe, swa be were swa be wite swa be lahslite swa be ealre are.
Gif hwa hadbryce gewirce, gebete þæt be hades mæðe, swa be were swa be wite swa be lahslite swa be ealre are.
Si quis ordinis infracturam faciat, emendet hoc secundum ordinis dignitatem: wera, wita, láhslite et omni misericordia (seu per omnia que possidet).
Gif hwá hadbryce gewyrce, gebete þæt be ðæs hades mæðe, swa be were swa be wite swa be lahslite swa be ealre are.

If anyone injures one of the clergy, he shall make amends according to the rank of the person injured, either by the payment of [his] wergeld or a fine or lahslit, or by the forfeiture of all his property.

If anyone commits an offence against a man in holy orders, he is to pay compensation for it according to the status of the orders, whether by wergild or by fine or by lahslit or by all his possessions.

Wenn jemand Klerus-Verletzung verübt, büsse er das nach Verhältniss des geistlichen Ranges [des Verletzten]: entweder durch [sein] Wergeld oder durch Strafgeld oder durch Rechtsbruchbusse oder durch [seinen] ganzen Besitz.
If anyone commits a violation of holy orders, let him make amends according to the rank of [the injured man's] orders: either by [his] wergild or by a fine or by lahslit or by [his] whole property.
